issue_context.title: Documentation improvement regarding returned datatype of pandas.unique
issue_context.body:
It's not clear in which case `pandas.unique` returns [numpy.ndarray](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/reference/generated/numpy.ndarray.html) and in which case it returns [ExtensionArray](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/reference/api/pandas.api.extensions.ExtensionArray.html)

https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/4bfe3d07b4858144c219b9346329027024102ab6/pandas/core/algorithms.py#L351
